parameters.content:
## Fillout to Folk

Applications land in Folk → **Pipeline (new)**. Deduped by email: existing person is updated, new person is created. Every submission writes **two notes**: the sectioned application, then a Claude-written review of it.

### How "Other" works
Whatever an applicant types into an Other box goes into the **main Folk field, verbatim**. There is no companion field.

Option lists and question types are fetched live from Fillout on every run, so:
- answers matching a real option are written using Fillout's exact label (strips stray spaces, normalises quotes)
- single vs multi select is detected automatically
- adding a question, rewording an option or enabling Other needs **no change here**

Trade-off: free text creates a new option on the Folk select, so those fields will accumulate one-off values. Worth an occasional tidy.

### The AI review
Three nodes sit between **Has Email?** and **Search Person In Folk**:

1. **Build AI Review Request** — the only node to edit. Model, search budget and the full brief live in the CONFIG block at the top.
2. **AI Application Review** — POSTs to the Anthropic Messages API with the `web_search` server tool switched on. Claude does the competitor research itself; there is no separate search credential.
3. **Extract AI Review** — pulls the prose out and drops the search tool blocks.

The review covers: recommended programme (Grow / Explore / Ideate), revenue numbers if Grow, a summary of the business, competitors with funding and stage if Grow or Explore, and a fit read ending in a yes / no / borderline call.

It is posted as its **own note**, by **Log AI Review (new person)** or **Log AI Review (existing person)**, at the very end of each branch. Written after the application note so it is the newer of the two.

Expect **30–90 seconds** per application and roughly **10–25 cents** in API spend, mostly web search.

**If Anthropic fails**, the node retries once then carries on. Both notes still write; the review note carries a placeholder line. Check `_reviewOk` and `_reviewError` on Extract AI Review.

### Editing
Only genuine decisions live in the CONFIG blocks of **Build Folk Payload** (field renames, Yes/No collapsing, note sections, list of Folk fields) and **Build AI Review Request** (model and prompt).

After a run, check Build Folk Payload:
- `_fields` — every Folk field written
- `_warnings` — anything withheld

A question with no matching Folk field is reported and skipped, never sent — so a form change cannot break the write. It still appears in the note under "Other".

### Behaviour to remember
**Status** resets to `Applied` on every submission, create or update. The re-application note records what it was before.

Field values are the latest answer only. Notes are the full history — two per submission, each application note carrying its own Fillout ID.

### Wiring
- Folk credential: **Folk API - new key**. Old workflows still use the old key.
- Anthropic credential: **Anthropic account**.
- Errors → **Error handler → Slack**, posts to #-dq-n8n-errors. Retries on every HTTP node first.
- Form ID is set in **two** places: the trigger, and the Fetch Form Definition URL.
